description: This file is a shell script used for testing git pack corruption resilience, including creating test files, corrupting pack objects, validating recovery mechanisms, and applying delta operations. It contains functions for manipulating git pack files, as well as numerous test cases for verifying the integrity and recovery processes.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Generates test files with random data and specific labels for subsequent pack creation and corruption tests.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Initializes a git repository, creates blobs for test files, and packs them into a pack file, verifying the pack's integrity.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Recreates pack files, replacing the existing pack with a new one, potentially introducing or fixing corruption.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Introduces corruption into a specified object within the pack by modifying its byte offset in the pack file.
